title: EvaluatorOutput
description: Final evaluator output for the Sentence Structure evaluator. This is the classify_complexity step's output -- the sentence_analysis step's own rich structured output (~30 grammatical counts) is an internal intermediate artifact, not part of this contract.

complexity_score.description: The sentence structure complexity level of the text.

reasoning.description: Detailed, pedagogically appropriate reasoning explaining how the qualitative structure and quantitative sentence statistics combine to produce the chosen complexity level.
